brief.t: FIRST — collect Ashley / Nymphaea’s next payment this morning. She has signed the updated agreement and asked for an invoice with payment link for 50% of the Miron glass-container amount; the $5,644.50 manufacturing deposit is already paid. Send only a verified glass amount and payment link, then confirm the order can be placed.

SECOND — Terra Lotus quote and contract were due yesterday and cannot quietly slide. Confirm the 22,000-unit total against the 21,000 reference, lock every verified cost and lead-time input, obtain approval, and deliver. Do not invent pricing.
THIRD — stop any BuffMan filling-line commitment until the $8,850 DDP quote, machine scope, hot-fill capability, batch-coding method, and total landed cost are verified in writing.

FOURTH — protect customer delivery truth: obtain Natugeda Hair Oil’s real production stage and next date before any update. PHYLARA is paused after sample satisfaction and needs release-permission, formula/specification, and balance confirmation.

FIFTH — respond to new revenue with qualification, not promises. Salty Pup has a formula and packaging and is seeking manufacturing; Shay Brands is booked for August 3 at noon ET and needs tiered 500/1,000/1,500-unit pricing preparation. The new chelating-shampoo inquiry needs formula/claims and MOQ qualification.

SIXTH — resolve cash and continuity gates: validate bitop, CH Robinson, and BuffMan exposure against internal records; complete DTE start-service instructions; then update UPS, USPS, and Shopify to the live Farmington Hills address and test each workflow.

next: Send Ashley the verified 50% Miron glass-container invoice/payment link; confirm order placement after payment
Close Terra Lotus: confirm 22,000 units, verify every cost/lead-time input, approve, and send quote plus contract
Gate BuffMan: written hot-fill, coding, scope, DDP inclusion, and final landed-cost confirmation before any commitment
Get Natugeda production facts before customer communication

kb.a: Ashley / Nymphaea signed the updated agreement and requested an invoice with payment link for 50% of the Miron glass-container amount. She states the $5,644.50 50% manufacturing deposit is already paid. Verify the glass amount and supplier order path before invoicing; white natural-paper labels remain the selected direction.

Terra Lotus remains the major quote and contract priority, now overdue from July 30. The customer’s WhatsApp line items total 22,000 units, while a 21,000-unit reference must be reconciled. Do not issue pricing until formula, packaging, labor, overhead, freight, lead time, and approved margin are verified.

BuffMan equipment remains gated. The forwarded freight quote is USD 8,850 DDP, and hot-fill capability, batch-coding method, equipment configuration, quote inclusions, and final landed cost are not verified. No payment, order, or shipment commitment is authorized from current evidence.

Natugeda needs a factual Hair Oil production stage and next date. CRM is not authenticated and the historical Production Scheduled label is not a current operations fact. Get operations confirmation before customer communication.

PHYLARA is satisfied with the sample but pausing for personal-timeline reasons. The customer requested final formula/specifications and any remaining balance. Confirm release permission, document control, and ledger status before responding.

Salty Pup Newport Beach is a new manufacturing inquiry introduced by Ronald. Susan says the formula is complete and she has bottles, labels, and a label applicator; she seeks the right manufacturing partner. Confirm formula transfer, claims, batch size, compatibility, testing, and production requirements before promising price or timing.

Jarrod Adams of Shay Brands is booked for Monday, August 3 at 12:00 PM ET. He wants a custom whipped tallow body moisturizer plus white-label scrub and night cream, with later shampoo, conditioner, and body wash; he requested 500, 1,000, and 1,500-unit tiers. Prepare qualification and validated commercial inputs, not a speculative quote.

A new web inquiry asks about treatment-strength chelating shampoo. Determine intended claims, active ingredients, target user, quantity, packaging, and budget before making a manufacturing or regulatory representation. Treatment-strength positioning may require classification review.

PLL operates at 24600 N. Industrial Dr., Farmington Hills, MI 48335. Customer notification is complete, but UPS, USPS, and Shopify address changes and a test workflow remain pending. DTE also sent a start-service reminder that needs completion.
bitop AG’s dunning notice requires ledger matching before payment. Amount, original invoice, and any material or production hold are not verified in this refresh. Do not pay from an email link.
CH Robinson invoice 6247783636 for load 555812351 remains unvalidated. Confirm amount, due date, shipment linkage, and delivery status internally before payment or a customer commitment.

Victor was reached by phone and is expected to obtain R&D confirmation of Edge Control packaging compatibility. Compatibility timing and final cost inputs are still unverified. The quote cannot close without both.

CRM was at the sign-in screen during the July 31 refresh. The last authenticated capture showed 11 tasks, 8 overdue, 9 active deals, $1,327,800 pipeline, 20 projects in production, and $57,454.99 deposits; these are not live verified. The customer-page Assign To issue also lacks verified closure.
